coverPage.title: Sophie PA Packet Lint Report
coverPage.disclaimer: Sophie Prior-Auth Packet Linter is a deterministic checklist. It is not medical advice. It is not legal advice. It is not coding advice. It does not transmit anything to any payer. Your packet stays in this browser tab; we never see your data. Findings reflect what Sophie's ruleset checks; they are not a guarantee of payer approval. A passing report does not mean the packet will be approved; a failing report does not mean the packet will be denied. The clinical adequacy of every document is the reviewer's responsibility. Sophie's ruleset is versioned and cites every source; verify citations against current payer policy before relying on any finding for a clinical or revenue decision.

findings.description: Medicare FFS hospital-outpatient service on the CMS OPD Required Prior Authorization list: UTN / prior-authorization reference present
findings.citation: CMS requires prior authorization for certain hospital outpatient department (OPD) services -- blepharoplasty, botulinum toxin injection, panniculectomy, rhinoplasty, vein ablation (2020), cervical fusion with disc removal, implanted spinal neurostimulators (2021), and facet joint interventions (2023) -- before the service is furnished; the provider receives a Unique Tracking Number (UTN) that must appear on the claim. A listed OPD service requested without that authorization / UTN is a likely RFI or denial. <https://www.cms.gov/data-research/monitoring-programs/medicare-fee-service-compliance-programs/prior-authorization-pre-claim-review-initiatives/prior-authorization-certain-hospital-outpatient-department-opd-services>
findings.note: Requested service CPT 36475 (vein ablation) is on the CMS Hospital OPD Required Prior Authorization list and is furnished in the hospital outpatient department, but no Unique Tracking Number (UTN) / prior-authorization reference is documented. Medicare requires OPD prior authorization, and the UTN on the claim, before the service is furnished.
findings.remediation: Address the rule's `note` field and resubmit.

findings.description: Aetna precertification: applicable coverage criteria identified when known
findings.citation: Aetna says a coverage determination is based on plan documents and, when applicable, clinical information; criteria used during review may include Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletins, CMS coverage guidance, MCG, ASAM, LOCUS, CALOCUS-CASII, or ABA guidelines. Aetna does not say every submission must cite the criterion. <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/precertification.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna precertification: supporting clinical information available for coverage review
findings.citation: Aetna says a coverage determination may include review of clinical information to decide whether coverage criteria are met. Its provider-forms page links procedure-specific information request forms; the overview does not require records with every notification or request. <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/precertification.html> <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/health-care-professional-forms.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna precertification: supported submission channels noted for routing
findings.citation: Aetna accepts precertification by electronic data interchange (EDI), its secure provider website, or the phone number on the member ID card. The page does not require the selected channel to be written in the packet. <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/precertification.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna precertification: requested service is on Aetna's participating-provider precertification list
findings.citation: Aetna precertification applies to services on its participating-provider or behavioral-health precertification lists, services required by the member's plan, and Medicare Advantage organization-determination requests. This app ships no bundled Aetna list, so this rule remains a non-enforcing reminder. <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/precertification.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna precertification: requested spinal-surgery questionnaire / information request form answered
findings.citation: Aetna's spinal-surgery form says to complete a questionnaire if asked and to submit the form after a pended response. It warns that failure to complete the form and provide requested records may delay review or lead to denial; a spinal-surgery request alone does not prove Aetna requested the form. <https://www.aetna.com/content/dam/aetna/pdfs/aetnacom/health-care-professionals/documents-forms/spinal-surgery-precert-form.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna concurrent review: current condition and clinical progress documented
findings.citation: Aetna describes concurrent review as utilization management performed while a patient is actively receiving treatment. Aetna collects information from the care team about the patient's condition and progress, and Aetna creates and reviews a discharge and continuing-care plan. The page does not impose those elements on every initial inpatient precertification packet. <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/utilization-management/concurrent-review.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna site-of-care review: member-specific hospital-outpatient MRI / CT requirement addressed
findings.citation: Aetna's 2026 participating-provider precertification list says some members have site-of-care requirements for MRI and CT requested in a hospital outpatient setting. It does not establish a universal requirement for every Aetna member. <https://www.aetna.com/content/dam/aetna/pdfs/aetnacom/healthcare-professionals/2026_Precert_List.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna expedited / urgent precertification: clinical urgency justification present
findings.citation: Packet-internal completeness check: when a request asks for expedited handling, recording its clinical urgency prevents an unsupported priority label. Aetna's current commercial precertification overview does not publish a universal expedited criterion, so this rule is informational and source-free.
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna eyelid surgery: functional upper-lid request includes photographs and visual-field testing
findings.citation: Aetna CPB 0084 requires recent photographs and taped/untaped visual-field testing for upper-lid blepharoplasty or ptosis repair requested to correct functional visual impairment. Ptosis repair also requires a margin-reflex-distance measurement. The CPB lists other covered indications, so an eyelid procedure name alone does not trigger these functional-impairment criteria. <https://www.aetna.com/cpb/medical/data/1_99/0084.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna precertification: applicable administration code included for a drug / injectable request
findings.citation: Aetna's general Precertification Information Request Form asks for CPT/HCPCS codes and says drug or injectable requests should include any administration codes. The form does not state the universal NDC requirement previously attributed to it. <https://www.aetna.com/content/dam/aetna/pdfs/aetnacom/pharmacy-insurance/healthcare-professional/documents/precert-information-request-form.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna Medicare Part B step therapy: preferred-drug trial or clinical exception documented when the request identifies a step-therapy requirement
findings.citation: For Aetna Medicare Advantage Part B drugs subject to step therapy, Aetna requires a preferred-drug trial before a non-preferred drug. The requirement does not apply after treatment with the requested drug in the past 365 days, and providers may explain why preferred drugs are not medically appropriate. The page does not apply step therapy to every J-code or commercial drug request. <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/medicare/part-b-drug-um.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna primary bariatric surgery (CPB 0157): qualifying BMI and the documented 12-session intensive multicomponent intervention are present
findings.citation: Aetna CPB 0157 requires a qualifying BMI for primary bariatric surgery and a documented intensive multicomponent behavioral intervention with at least 12 sessions in the 2 years before surgery. The intervention must address nutrition, physical activity, and behavioral modification; it need not be physician-supervised. <https://www.aetna.com/cpb/medical/data/100_199/0157.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna WES / WGS (CPB 0140): genetics evaluation and independent pre- and post-test counseling documented
findings.citation: Aetna CPB 0140 requires, for whole exome or whole genome sequencing, evaluation or consultation by a qualified genetics specialist and pre- and post-test counseling by an appropriate independent provider. These are WES/WGS criteria, not universal requirements for every molecular-pathology test. <https://www.aetna.com/cpb/medical/data/100_199/0140.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna retrospective / retroactive request: a retro-review justification is documented
findings.citation: Packet-completeness reminder: if a request is labeled retrospective or retroactive, explain why the service preceded authorization. The reviewed Aetna commercial precertification page does not publish a universal retrospective-review eligibility rule. Informational and source-free.
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna Outpatient Surgical Procedures program: a named elective procedure requested at a hospital outpatient site documents the medical-necessity rationale
findings.citation: Aetna may require hospital-outpatient site-of-service precertification for the elective procedures named on its Outpatient Surgical Procedures page. Those procedures should use an ASC or office when clinically appropriate, and a hospital-outpatient exception requires clinical rationale and documentation. The page does not apply this program to every surgical CPT or to inpatient care. Informational. <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/outpatient-surgical-procedures.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna DME / home-health request: signed written-order reminder
findings.citation: Packet-completeness reminder: a DME or home-health request may need a signed written order under the applicable benefit, supplier, or regulatory rules. The reviewed Aetna commercial precertification page does not publish a universal signed-order packet requirement. Informational and source-free.
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna major-organ transplant / stem-cell transfer / CAR-T precertification: National Medical Excellence routing identified
findings.citation: Aetna's participating-provider precertification list directs CAR-T drugs, major-organ transplant evaluations and transplants, and bone-marrow replacement or stem-cell transfer through the National Medical Excellence Program by phone. It does not state that every packet must include a transplant-center evaluation. Informational. <https://www.aetna.com/content/dam/aetna/pdfs/aetnacom/healthcare-professionals/2026_Precert_List.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna request explicitly labeled experimental / investigational: applicable CPB, plan, or appeal basis identified
findings.citation: Aetna says its CPBs express whether services are medically necessary, experimental, investigational, unproven, or cosmetic; the member's benefit plan governs, determinations are case-by-case, and members may appeal. The page does not say every off-label service or clinical-trial request is investigational or require providers to attach peer-reviewed literature. Informational. <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/precertification.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna post-service appeal: explanation, supporting records, and original denial / claim reference are present
findings.citation: For a post-service appeal, Aetna asks for a clear explanation, supporting documents, the denial letter or EOB and original claim for reference, and a dispute-and-appeal form unless filing through Availity. Reconsiderations have a different documented field set. <https://www.aetna.com/health-care-professionals/disputes-appeals/disputes-appeals-overview.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Aetna out-of-network request: plan benefits and precertification responsibility are identified
findings.citation: Aetna says out-of-network coverage depends on the member's plan, some plans cover out-of-network care only for emergencies, and the member handles precertification when using an out-of-network provider. It does not publish a universal network-gap or continuity-of-care justification requirement on this page. Informational. <https://www.aetna.com/individuals-families/using-your-aetna-benefits/network-out-of-network-care.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Aetna packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Anthem prior authorization: applicable medical-necessity resource identified
findings.citation: Anthem describes Medical Policies and Clinical UM Guidelines as references for interpreting claim decisions, notes that guideline adoption varies by plan, and may also use MCG or Carelon criteria. It does not require every authorization packet to cite a policy. This is an informational preparation check only. <https://www.anthem.com/provider/policies/clinical-guidelines/>
findings.evidence: Not an Anthem packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Anthem prior authorization: recommended supporting clinical documentation attached
findings.citation: Anthem's Medical Policy and Clinical UM Guideline page calls the documents returned by its Clinical Documentation Lookup Tool "highly recommended" for prior-authorization and claim submission. This informational check does not turn that recommendation into a universal attachment mandate. <https://www.anthem.com/provider/policies/clinical-guidelines/>
findings.evidence: Not an Anthem packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Anthem prior authorization: use the applicable digital authorization workflow
findings.citation: Anthem directs providers to submit and track medical or behavioral-health authorization cases through the Authorization application in Availity Essentials. The public page does not require the packet content itself to record which channel transported it. <https://www.anthem.com/provider/individual-commercial/prior-authorization>
findings.evidence: Not an Anthem packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Anthem prior authorization: requested service checked against the applicable state and plan list
findings.citation: Anthem publishes separate prior-authorization code lists by state and plan and directs providers to use those lists to identify services requiring authorization. The linter ships no universal Anthem list, so it cannot infer a requirement from a code alone. <https://www.anthem.com/provider/individual-commercial/prior-authorization>
findings.evidence: Not an Anthem packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Anthem submitted authorization: case or tracking reference documented

findings.description: Highmark out-of-network gap-exception request: missing-service rationale documented
findings.citation: Highmark says prior authorization and out-of-network gap exceptions are separate requests. findings.evidence: Not a Highmark packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.evidence: Not a HMSA (Blue Cross Blue Shield of Hawaii) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.evidence: Not a HMSA (Blue Cross Blue Shield of Hawaii) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: HMSA (Blue Cross Blue Shield of Hawaii) prior authorization: submission channel (HHIN / provider portal / phone on member ID card) indicated

findings.evidence: Not a HMSA (Blue Cross Blue Shield of Hawaii) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Explicit Humana network-gap / continuity exception: access or treatment rationale is documented
findings.citation: Operational completeness advisory: an explicit network-gap, continuity-of-care, or transition-of-care exception request should state the access or active-treatment reason. Generic out-of-network status alone does not establish this workflow. Informational.
findings.evidence: Not a Humana packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross precertification: applicable medical policy identified when known
findings.citation: IBX policy bulletins are used for medical-necessity decisions but do not describe member benefits or require every precertification submission to cite a policy. Identifying a known policy is an informational aid, not a submission prerequisite. <https://www.ibx.com/resources/for-providers/policies-and-guidelines/operations-management/medical-policy.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross precertification: request-specific clinical information available when review requires it
findings.citation: IBX says its Utilization Management department evaluates cases that require clinical review; it does not impose one fixed clinical-document attachment on every request. This is an informational completeness check. <https://www.ibx.com/resources/for-providers/policies-and-guidelines/operations-management/preapproval-requirements.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross precertification: use the member- and service-specific submission workflow
findings.citation: IBX directs participating providers to PEAR Practice Management for facility and office precertification requests, with phone and delegated-service routes also documented. The transport channel does not need to appear in packet content. <https://www.ibx.com/resources/for-providers/policies-and-guidelines/operations-management/preapproval-requirements.html> <https://www.ibx.com/resources/for-providers/contact-us/index.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross precertification: requested service checked against the current member-specific requirements
findings.citation: IBX publishes dated precertification lists and directs providers to PEAR Practice Management for the most current requirements. The linter has no live member, benefit, or PEAR lookup, so this reminder is non-enforcing. <https://www.ibx.com/resources/for-providers/policies-and-guidelines/operations-management/preapproval-requirements.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross submitted precertification: confirmation or decision reference retained
findings.citation: IBX accepts precertification requests through PEAR Practice Management or the applicable phone route and notifies providers after a decision. An initial request cannot already contain that confirmation, so this advisory runs only when the packet says submission is complete. <https://www.ibx.com/resources/for-providers/policies-and-guidelines/operations-management/preapproval-requirements.html>
findings.evidence: Not an Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross concurrent inpatient review: current clinical status, treatment plan, progress, and discharge-plan update present
findings.citation: The current IBX Hospital Manual distinguishes initial admission review from concurrent review. For a per-diem continued-stay review, the hospital must provide current medical information, the treatment plan, progress on goals, and a discharge-plan update; DRG stays instead receive requested clinical updates at day 14 and every 14 days thereafter. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Hospital/IBX_Hospital_06_Clinical-Services-UM.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross advanced-imaging review: outpatient MRI / CT / PET carries the clinical indication for Independence Blue Cross's advanced-imaging utilization-management program
findings.citation: IBX routes nonemergency outpatient CT/CTA, MRI/MRA, PET, and nuclear-cardiology precertification to Carelon, though self-funded groups can opt out. The linked Carelon request form requires symptoms or diagnosis, the clinical question, prior treatment, and relevant testing. A generic 7xxxx radiology code does not by itself establish that this program applies. <https://www.ibx.com/resources/for-providers/contact-us/index.html> <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Provider/IBX_Provider_06_Clinical-Services-UM.pdf> <https://www.ibx.com/documents/35221/56629/carelon-request-form.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross explicit expedited request: clinical-urgency rationale documented
findings.citation: The current IBX Provider Manual identifies an expedited determination workflow for Medicare Part B drugs but does not make every packet containing the word urgent or STAT an expedited request. This broader clinical-urgency check is therefore informational and runs only when the packet explicitly requests expedited authorization or review. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Provider/IBX_Provider_06_Clinical-Services-UM.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross Most Cost-Effective Setting review: requested specialty-drug treatment setting documented
findings.citation: IBX's Most Cost-Effective Setting Program reviews the requested treatment setting only for the specialty medical-benefit medications on its current program list. The published program does not establish a universal hospital-outpatient exception rule for surgery or imaging. <https://www.ibx.com/pdfs/resources/for-providers/most-cost-effective.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross medical-benefit drug precertification: member height and weight documented
findings.citation: The current IBX Provider Manual requires member height and weight for drugs covered under the medical benefit that require precertification. Neither the manual nor IBX's general medical-benefit precertification page makes an NDC a universal authorization-packet field for every J-code. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Provider/IBX_Provider_06_Clinical-Services-UM.pdf> <https://www.ibx.com/resources/for-providers/policies-and-guidelines/operations-management/preapproval-requirements.html>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross pharmacy step therapy: prerequisite medication history documented when the packet says step therapy applies
findings.citation: IBX step therapy applies only to designated medications and may be satisfied when pharmacy claims show a recent step-1 medication. IBX's general pharmacy prior-authorization form also asks for medication history, including drug names and dates. The linter therefore gives an informational reminder only when the packet explicitly says step therapy applies. <https://www.ibx.com/pdfs/resources/for-providers/formularies/premium-st-drug-list.pdf> <https://www.ibx.com/documents/35221/851945/value-prior-authorization.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross testing laboratory: eviCore precertification is on file before an applicable genetic / genomic test
findings.citation: The current IBX Specialty Programs manual says only certain genetic/genomic tests require eviCore precertification and that self-funded groups may opt out. When an applicable testing request reaches a laboratory, the laboratory must ensure precertification is on file before rendering the service. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Provider/IBX_Provider_11_Specialty-Programs.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross Direct Ship general drug request: ICD-10 diagnosis documented
findings.citation: The current IBX Direct Ship general request form is limited to medical-benefit drugs available through that program and explicitly requires the diagnosis for the requested drug, including ICD-10. This requirement is not inferred from every J-code or specialty-drug mention. <https://www.ibx.com/ResourceCenter/IBX-direct-ship-drug-request-form.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross retrospective inpatient review: a qualifying limited circumstance is documented
findings.citation: The current IBX Hospital Manual limits retrospective inpatient review to specified circumstances: coverage was unknown when service began; IBX eligibility was discovered after discharge following classification under different coverage; or discharge occurred before medical review finished. It separately explains the PEAR route for a missed emergency-admission notification. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Hospital/IBX_Hospital_06_Clinical-Services-UM.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross DME / home-health authorization: follow the current service- and member-specific submission requirement
findings.citation: The current IBX Provider Manual distinguishes these workflows: providers may submit authorization requests for infusion, prosthetic, or DME services, while authorization requests for home-health services must be submitted. The reviewed IBX guidance does not establish a universal signed-and-dated-order packet requirement across both categories, and the linter has no live member lookup. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Provider/IBX_Provider_06_Clinical-Services-UM.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross ABA authorization: current ABA form and supporting documents included
findings.citation: For ABA dates of service on or after April 1, 2026, IBX requires providers to submit the current ABA prior-authorization form with all supporting documents. The requirement is specific to ABA requests and is not inferred from generic behavioral-health language. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/news/Pages/Reminder-ABA-services-transitioned-to-IBX-on-April-1-2026.aspx>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross transplant request: apply only member-specific network requirements
findings.citation: IBX describes Blue Distinction as a national quality-designation program that helps members identify recognized specialty centers, including transplant centers. The reviewed guidance does not establish universal Blue Distinction routing or a universal transplant-evaluation attachment requirement. <https://www.ibx.com/resources/for-members/quality-management.html>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross experimental / investigational classification: reliable-evidence basis documented
findings.citation: The current IBX Clinical Services manual defines when a service is experimental/investigational and when reliable evidence establishes otherwise. FDA-approved off-label drug use may instead be supported by an accepted compendium, so off-label or clinical-trial language alone does not trigger this check. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Provider/IBX_Provider_06_Clinical-Services-UM.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross provider-filed member appeal: signed member consent and supporting records included
findings.citation: The current IBX Appeals manual says a provider filing an internal appeal on a member's behalf must first obtain written member consent and is responsible for supporting documentation such as office or medical records. Appeals without signed member consent cannot be processed. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Provider/IBX_Provider_15_Appeals.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Independence Blue Cross HMO / PCP-referred POS out-of-network request: referral and network-unavailability criteria documented
findings.citation: The current IBX Clinical Services manual requires HMO out-of-network referrals to be precertified and says the member must first receive care from a participating provider in the same recognized specialty, obtain a PCP referral, and be advised that no participating provider can offer the service. PCP-referred POS requests follow the same path; PPO members may use out-of-network benefits. <https://provcomm.ibx.com/pnc-ibc/Manuals/Provider/IBX_Provider_06_Clinical-Services-UM.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a Independence Blue Cross packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Infusion / specialty drug: NDC value documented when the payer or transaction requires it
findings.citation: FDA currently assigns 10-digit NDCs in three segment shapes; HIPAA reimbursement uses a zero-padded 11-digit 5-4-2 derivative. NDC listing does not establish FDA approval or payer coverage. This conservative heuristic flags every J-code packet without an actual NDC value; payer requirements still control.
findings.evidence: No J-code in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Infusion / specialty drug: weight-based dose calculation shown when dosing is per kg
findings.citation: Weight-based biologic / chemotherapy infusions require an explicit weight + dose calculation so the payer can verify the dose against FDA labeling.
findings.evidence: No J-code in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Infusion / specialty drug: site-of-care indicator (home / clinic / hospital infusion) documented
findings.citation: Payers route specialty-drug PAs to different review queues based on site of care (home infusion has different rules than hospital outpatient); the packet must label the planned site.
findings.evidence: No J-code in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Infusion / specialty drug: labeled indication or payer-supported off-label rationale referenced
findings.citation: FDA-approved prescribing information identifies labeled indications, but clinicians may prescribe approved drugs off label when medically appropriate. Coverage of off-label use is a separate payer decision; this heuristic looks for either a labeled indication or a payer-recognized compendia / off-label rationale.
findings.evidence: No J-code in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Infusion / specialty drug: premedication / infusion-reaction monitoring plan documented
findings.citation: Many biologics carry an infusion-reaction risk (rituximab, infliximab, IV iron, etc.); the packet should reference a premedication regimen or in-suite monitoring plan when the drug carries that risk.
findings.evidence: No J-code in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage HMO: PCP referral present for specialist services
findings.citation: MA HMO and HMO-POS plans require a PCP referral before non-emergent specialist services unless the member has an open-access benefit.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage: in-network status confirmed OR out-of-network exception documented
findings.citation: MA plans pay differently in vs. out of network; the packet should indicate the servicing provider's network status, or an OON exception (continuity-of-care, urgent / emergent, network inadequacy) when going OON.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage gatekeepered plan: servicing specialist NPI distinct from ordering PCP NPI
findings.citation: On a gatekeepered MA plan, the specialist NPI on the PA must differ from the ordering PCP NPI; both must be Luhn-valid and present in the packet.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage: plan name + member-ID format present on the packet
findings.citation: MA plans require the plan name on the request form and a member ID matching the plan's issuer-specific format; without both the payer cannot route the PA to the correct plan unit.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage: service location is within the plan's service area
findings.citation: MA plans cover specific geographies; an out-of-area service location triggers different cost-share and may require an OON exception. checks for a service-location / service-area anchor; + will tie this to the bundled CMS plan-service-area files when those land.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage drug request: Part B vs Part D coverage path indicated
findings.citation: MA plans cover drugs under Part B (physician-administered, DME-administered, certain immunosuppressives) and Part D (most outpatient prescriptions); the packet must indicate which coverage path applies so the plan routes the PA to the correct review queue.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage D-SNP (dual-eligible Special Needs Plan): Medicaid plan information documented
findings.citation: D-SNP enrollees have both Medicare (via the MA plan) and Medicaid; coordinated benefits require the state Medicaid plan name and member ID on the PA so cost-share and coverage gaps can be resolved.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage supplemental benefit (dental / vision / hearing): plan-covered-benefit anchor documented
findings.citation: MA plans often offer supplemental dental, vision, and hearing benefits that are NOT in Original Medicare; the packet should indicate the benefit is covered under the plan's Evidence of Coverage before submission.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage Part B drug: step-therapy compliance documented when plan applies step therapy
findings.citation: Per CMS final rule (effective 2019), MA plans may apply step therapy to Part B drugs; when step therapy applies, the prior-trial / failure documentation must be attached.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage inpatient admission: two-midnight expectation or short-stay criteria documented
findings.citation: CMS extended the two-midnight rule to MA plans effective 2024; an inpatient admission requires a documented expectation that the patient will need 2+ midnights of medically necessary hospital care, or short-stay criteria for case-by-case approval.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage: organization determination type (pre-service / concurrent / payment) indicated
findings.citation: CMS Chapter 13 distinguishes organization determinations by stage (pre-service before delivery, concurrent during ongoing care, payment after delivery). The packet should label which type is being requested so MA plan timeliness rules apply correctly.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage expedited review: clinical urgency / serious-jeopardy attestation present
findings.citation: Under 42 CFR §§ 422.570 and 422.572, an expedited organization determination requires serious jeopardy to the enrollee's life, health, or ability to regain maximum function and is due within 72 hours. Beginning January 1, 2026, § 422.568 gives standard service or item requests subject to the § 422.122 prior-authorization rules a 7-calendar-day deadline.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage transition fill: continuity-of-care anchor for new enrollee within 90 days of effective date
findings.citation: CMS requires MA plans to honor a transition supply / continuity-of-care period (typically 90 days) for new enrollees on existing therapies; the packet should indicate the transition window when applicable.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage: hospice-election indicator (hospice services revert to Original Medicare)
findings.citation: When an MA enrollee elects the Medicare hospice benefit, hospice-related services revert to Original Medicare; the MA plan continues to cover non-hospice services. The packet must indicate the hospice-election status when relevant so the PA routes to the correct payer.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medicare Advantage C-SNP / I-SNP: qualifying chronic condition or institutional status documented
findings.citation: Chronic-condition SNPs (C-SNPs) require documented diagnosis of a qualifying chronic condition (e.g., diabetes, CHF, ESRD, dementia); institutional SNPs (I-SNPs) require documented nursing-facility residence. The PA must reference the qualifying condition.
findings.evidence: Not Medicare Advantage; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) prior authorization: coverage criteria (Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) Medical Policy / MCG) referenced
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) adjudicates prior-authorization requests against its published Medical Policies (and MCG care guidelines); a request should cite the policy it is being judged against so the reviewer can map it to the coverage criteria. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) prior authorization: supporting medical records / clinical documentation attached
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) requires the clinical information that supports medical necessity to be submitted with the prior-authorization request; a request with no clinical document attached cannot be reviewed on the merits. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) prior authorization: submission channel (Medi-Cal Provider Portal / eTAR / phone) indicated
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) directs providers to submit prior-authorization requests through the Medi-Cal Provider Portal or an electronic Treatment Authorization Request (eTAR), by 278 EDI transaction, or by phone using the number on the member ID card. Informational: a cover sheet that names the channel speeds routing. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) prior authorization: requested service is on Medi-Cal (California Medicaid)'s prior-authorization / notification requirement list
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) prior authorization applies only to services on its published prior-authorization and notification lists; requesting authorization for a non-listed service is unnecessary. ships no bundled list, so the rule is vacuously satisfied with a pointer to the list (it mirrors core R-PA-053 and the the commercial overlay (Aetna through HMSA) -004 rules; a later wave bundles the list and flips this to a real membership test). <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) prior authorization: authorization is referenced for a service that requires it before the service date
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) requires prior authorization to be obtained before a service on its requirement list is rendered; a packet for an authorization-required service should show the authorization / reference number rather than relying on post-service review. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) inpatient prior authorization: admission notification + concurrent / continued-stay clinical review documentation present
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) requires admission notification and conducts concurrent (continued-stay) review for inpatient admissions, collecting the clinical update and discharge plan; an inpatient request should carry that documentation. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) advanced-imaging review: outpatient MRI / CT / PET carries the clinical indication for Medi-Cal (California Medicaid)'s advanced-imaging utilization-management program
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) delegates outpatient advanced-imaging (MRI / CT / PET / nuclear cardiology) prior authorization to its advanced-imaging utilization-management program; the request should carry the clinical indication that supports the study. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) expedited / urgent prior authorization: clinical urgency justification present
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) processes an expedited prior-authorization review when a standard timeframe could seriously jeopardize the member's life, health, or ability to regain maximum function. A request that asks for expedited handling should state that clinical urgency. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) site-of-care review: outpatient surgery / imaging addresses the hospital-outpatient vs. ASC / freestanding site-of-care requirement
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid)'s site-of-care medical policy directs certain outpatient surgical and imaging services to an ambulatory surgical center or freestanding facility unless hospital-outpatient care is medically necessary; a hospital-outpatient request should document why that site is required. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) prior authorization: NDC documented for a physician-administered (J-code) drug request
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) review of physician-administered (buy-and-bill) drugs maps the request to a specific product and dose via the National Drug Code in addition to the HCPCS J-code. Informational: a J-code request without an NDC routes more slowly. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) drug prior authorization: step-therapy prior-trial documentation (drugs tried + therapeutic failure) present
findings.citation: For drugs subject to step therapy Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) pharmacy management requires documentation of the prerequisite drugs tried and the therapeutic failure / intolerance for each before the requested agent is approved. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) genetic / molecular testing: the specific test and indication are documented for Medi-Cal (California Medicaid)'s genetic / molecular lab-management program
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) delegates genetic / molecular testing prior authorization to its lab-management program, which requires the specific test name (and, where applicable, the unique test identifier) plus the clinical indication. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) specialty / oncology drug: the supporting diagnosis is documented for the applicable Medical Policy
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) specialty and oncology drug coverage is governed by drug-specific Medical Policies that condition coverage on a supporting diagnosis (ICD-10) matching the policy's indication; the request should carry that diagnosis. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) retrospective / retroactive request: a retro-review justification is documented
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) considers a retrospective review only when the service was already rendered for a documented reason (e.g. emergent care, member eligibility not known at the time). A retro request should state that reason. Informational. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) DME / home-health prior authorization: a signed, dated written order / plan of care accompanies the request
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) prior authorization for durable medical equipment and home-health services requires a written order / plan of care, signed and dated by the ordering provider, before the item / service is dispensed. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) behavioral health: level-of-care criteria documentation present
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) behavioral-health prior authorization reviews the requested level of care against published level-of-care guidelines (e.g. MCG behavioral-health care guidelines, ASAM criteria); the request should document the criteria that support the level requested. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) transplant prior authorization: routed through a Medicaid-designated transplant center with a transplant-center evaluation
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) directs solid-organ and hematopoietic stem-cell transplants through a Medicaid-designated transplant center / Center of Excellence; a transplant prior authorization should reference that routing and carry the transplant-center evaluation. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) experimental / investigational determination: peer-reviewed evidence or a documented policy exception is present
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) excludes services its Medical Policy classifies as experimental, investigational, or unproven; a request for such a service must carry the peer-reviewed evidence or the documented exception the policy allows, or it will be denied. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) appeal / reconsideration / state fair hearing: references the original determination and adds new clinical information
findings.citation: When a prior authorization is resubmitted as an appeal, reconsideration, or state fair hearing, Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) asks the provider to reference the original determination and supply additional clinical information that addresses the denial reason. Informational. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) out-of-network / network-gap request: a continuity-of-care or network-gap justification is documented
findings.citation: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) reviews out-of-network prior authorization for a documented network gap or continuity-of-care reason (no participating provider with the required expertise, an active course of treatment). An out-of-network request should state that justification. Informational. <https://mcweb.apps.prd.cammis.medi-cal.ca.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Arizona Medicaid prior authorization: coverage criteria (Arizona Medicaid Medical Policy / MCG) referenced
findings.citation: Arizona Medicaid adjudicates prior-authorization requests against its published Medical Policies (and MCG care guidelines); a request should cite the policy it is being judged against so the reviewer can map it to the coverage criteria. <https://www.azahcccs.gov/>
findings.evidence: Not a Arizona Medicaid packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Arizona Medicaid prior authorization: supporting medical records / clinical documentation attached

findings.description: Radiology request: matching ACR Appropriateness Criteria topic or variant referenced
findings.citation: ACR Appropriateness Criteria are evidence-based clinical decision-support guidelines organized by condition, variant, and imaging procedure. ACR does not make an explicit AC citation a universal prior-authorization requirement; this informational heuristic checks whether the packet names the matching topic or variant.
findings.evidence: No radiology CPT (70010-79999) in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Non-emergent spine or extremity MRI: prior conservative management documented
findings.citation: ACR recommendations are specific to the clinical condition and variant; conservative treatment is not a universal prerequisite for MRI. This payer-completeness heuristic is limited to non-emergent spine and extremity MRI requests.
findings.evidence: No spine or extremity MRI CPT in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Contrast imaging study: prior-reaction and renal-risk screening documented; renal function when indicated
findings.citation: ACR Manual on Contrast Media: a prior reaction to the same contrast class is the strongest reaction-risk factor. Routine intravascular iodinated studies do not require baseline creatinine when renal-risk screening is negative; at-risk patients may warrant serum creatinine/eGFR assessment and individualized risk-benefit review.
findings.evidence: No radiology CPT in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Radiology procedure: preceding clinical evaluation referenced
findings.citation: Advanced imaging without a documented clinical evaluation (history, physical, working differential) is one of the most common denial reasons; the packet should reference a clinical note dated on or before the imaging request.
findings.evidence: No radiology CPT in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Pediatric ionizing-radiation study: ALARA / dose-reduction consideration documented
findings.citation: ACR Appropriateness Criteria report relative radiation levels for ionizing-radiation procedures, and Image Gently promotes pediatric dose reduction. This rule applies to ionizing studies such as CT, radiography, and nuclear medicine, not MRI or ultrasound.
findings.evidence: No ionizing-radiation CPT in packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: CMS LCD L40232 primary total hip/knee arthroplasty: conservative therapy or an exception rationale documented
findings.citation: CMS LCD L40232 requires a conservative-therapy trial for primary total hip or knee arthroplasty, while allowing documented exceptional circumstances when conservative therapy is not appropriate. This rule does not generalize that policy to every surgical CPT or payer.
findings.evidence: No primary total hip/knee arthroplasty CPT (27130 or 27447); rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: CMS LCD L40232 primary total hip/knee arthroplasty: radiographic findings supporting the indication documented
findings.citation: CMS LCD L40232 requires radiographic findings demonstrating advanced joint disease for primary total hip or knee arthroplasty. It does not establish a universal imaging prerequisite for every surgical CPT.
findings.evidence: No primary total hip/knee arthroplasty CPT (27130 or 27447); rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: Anesthesia workflow with ASA III-VI: preanesthesia assessment documented
findings.citation: ASA Basic Standards require a preanesthesia assessment for patients receiving anesthesia care and consultations as necessary. ASA Physical Status communicates comorbidity burden but does not by itself mandate a separate "medical clearance" or establish perioperative risk.
findings.evidence: No planned anesthesia-care anchor; rule does not infer anesthesia from a surgery CPT alone.

findings.description: Surgery: any documented ASA Physical Status field contains a valid class I-VI
findings.citation: ASA defines six Physical Status classes (I-VI) and an emergency modifier; the classification alone does not predict perioperative risk. This linter validates a supplied value but does not require ASA status on every prospective authorization packet.
findings.evidence: No ASA field supplied; ASA status is not treated as a universal PA prerequisite.

findings.description: Completed hospital surgery record: informed consent documented before surgery unless emergent
findings.citation: 42 CFR 482.51(b)(2) requires a properly executed informed-consent form in the hospital chart before an operation, except in emergencies. It does not require a completed consent form in every prospective prior-authorization submission.
findings.evidence: No completed inpatient/hospital-outpatient surgery record; prospective PA packets are outside this consent check.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare prior authorization: applicable coverage policy reference identified when available
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare publishes Medical Policies, Medical Benefit Drug Policies, Coverage Determination Guidelines, and Utilization Review Guidelines. Its public materials do not state that every prior-authorization packet must cite one. Informational mapping aid. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/policies-protocols.html>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare prior authorization: request-specific supporting clinical documentation identified
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare says requests vary and providers should verify each request's specific clinical requirements; its portal supports uploading medical notes and attachments. The page does not say every request requires one of a fixed set of document types. Informational. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/prior-auth-advance-notification.html>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare prior authorization: electronic submission channel identified
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's 2026 Administrative Guide directs electronic submission through EDI 278, API, or the UnitedHealthcare Provider Portal. Phone or fax is accepted only where required or otherwise permitted. Informational. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/admin-guides/2026-UHC-Administrative-Guide.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare prior authorization: member-specific requirement lookup documented
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare directs providers to check requirements by member in the Provider Portal for the most accurate result and a Decision ID. Requirements also vary by plan and state. Informational; this repository does not bundle a member-specific requirement service. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/prior-auth-advance-notification/adv-notification-plan-reqs.html>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare advance notification: submitted notification carries a confirmation reference
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's Provider Portal can return a Decision ID from the member-specific requirements check, and its 2026 Administrative Guide says not to resubmit after receiving confirmation. The materials do not require a confirmation number in a packet that has not yet been submitted. Informational. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/prior-auth-advance-notification/adv-notification-plan-reqs.html>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare inpatient workflow: admission notification and, for concurrent review, clinical and discharge updates identified
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's 2026 Administrative Guide requires facilities subject to the protocol to provide admission and discharge notifications even when coverage approval is on file. Concurrent or retrospective inpatient review may request diagnoses, clinical information, the treatment plan, admission order, patient status, and discharge-planning information. Listed plans and delegated arrangements may follow separate protocols. Informational. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/admin-guides/2026-UHC-Administrative-Guide.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare advanced outpatient imaging: clinical condition documented when the radiology protocol applies
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's 2026 outpatient radiology protocol applies to certain CT, MRI, MRA, PET, and nuclear-cardiology services in outpatient or office settings, with listed plan exclusions. It does not apply in emergency, urgent-care, observation, or inpatient settings; MA does not require prior authorization for CT, MRI, or MRA. UHC may request the member's clinical condition, symptoms, prior treatment, and prior imaging. Informational. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/prior-auth/radiology/COMM-Exchange-Radiology-Prior-Auth-FAQ.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare expedited / urgent prior authorization: clinical urgency justification present
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's 2026 Administrative Guide requires an expedited request to explain the clinical urgency and provide required clinical information the same day. It lists short-term risk to life or health, impaired ability to regain maximum function, and severe disabling pain confirmed by a physician. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/admin-guides/2026-UHC-Administrative-Guide.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare in-scope outpatient-surgery site-of-service review: hospital-outpatient rationale documented
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's Outpatient Surgical Procedures Site of Service policy reviews only procedures on its Applicable Codes List when planned in a hospital outpatient department, and includes plan and state exclusions. When the policy applies, the hospital-outpatient setting must meet a listed patient-risk or ASC-access criterion. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/policies/comm-medical-drug/outpatient-surg-procedures-site-service.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare drug-claim handoff: 11-digit NDC documented for a professional or outpatient facility claim
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's 2026 commercial reimbursement policy requires a valid 11-digit NDC, unit of measure, and quantity dispensed on professional and outpatient-facility drug claims. This is a claim requirement, not a published prerequisite for every physician-administered-drug prior-authorization request. Informational handoff check. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/policies/comm-reimbursement/COMM-National-Drug-Code-Requirement-Policy.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare drug explicitly subject to step therapy: prerequisite trial or exception documented
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare says some drugs are subject to step therapy, which requires trying one drug before another, and provides an exception process when formulary restrictions do not accommodate a member's needs. The applicable drug list or policy determines the prerequisite; the guide does not impose one universal trial duration. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/admin-guides/2026-UHC-Administrative-Guide.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare in-scope genetic / molecular test: test, performing laboratory, and clinical indication identified
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's genetic and molecular testing program applies to listed plans and codes. Its program FAQ identifies the test name, laboratory-assigned unique identifier, associated CPT code, and laboratory identifiers; tests requiring prior authorization use an associated medical policy for clinical criteria. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/prior-auth/genetic-paan-faq.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare specialty / injectable drug request: ICD-10-CM diagnosis code documented
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's 2026 Administrative Guide lists an ICD-10-CM diagnosis code among the information every advance-notification or prior-authorization request must contain. Drug-specific policy matching remains a separate clinical determination. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/admin-guides/2026-UHC-Administrative-Guide.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare urgent radiology / cardiology retrospective request: urgency and after-hours reason documented
findings.citation: For urgent advanced imaging and specified cardiology procedures performed when authorization could not be requested outside normal business hours, UnitedHealthcare's 2026 Administrative Guide requires timely retrospective authorization documentation explaining both why the procedure was urgent and why authorization could not be requested during normal hours. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/admin-guides/2026-UHC-Administrative-Guide.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare DME request: ordering or prescribing provider documented
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's 2026 Administrative Guide defines DME as ordered or prescribed by a health care provider and directs readers to the applicable DME policy. It does not state here that every DME or home-health prior-authorization packet must contain a signed-and-dated written order. Informational. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/admin-guides/2026-UHC-Administrative-Guide.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare / Optum behavioral-health level-of-care request: supporting clinical assessment present
findings.citation: Optum uses LOCUS, CALOCUS-CASII, and ECSII as guidance for behavioral-health clinical decisions across most Commercial and Medicaid membership, while ASAM remains the criterion for substance-use services; applicability can vary by state, federal, or contractual requirements. This informational check looks for clinical assessment supporting an explicitly requested intensive level of care, not a named scoring tool. <https://public.providerexpress.com/content/ope-provexpr/us/en/clinical-resources/guidelines-policies/Adoption-of-LOCUS-CASII-ECSII.html>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare transplant request under an explicit Optum transplant protocol: approved facility identified
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's 2026 Administrative Guide states, in its capitation and delegation supplement, that transplant evaluations and surgery must occur at an Optum Center of Excellence or a facility approved by UnitedHealthcare or Optum medical directors. Because that routing depends on the group's transplant-risk arrangement, this informational rule runs only when the packet explicitly says the Optum transplant protocol applies. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/admin-guides/2026-UHC-Administrative-Guide.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare specialty drug explicitly listed as unproven: health-plan notification and benefit exception documented
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's Commercial and Individual Exchange Off-Label/Unproven Specialty Drug Treatment policy says a medical-benefit specialty drug that the corresponding policy lists as unproven for the requested indication requires health-plan notification and approval of a benefit exception. Other off-label pathways receive internal DPIS research, so this rule does not demand provider-supplied literature from every off-label or clinical-trial request. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/policies/comm-medical-drug/off-label-unproven-specialty-drug-treatment.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare urgent pre-service appeal: published urgency basis documented
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare distinguishes pre-service appeals from the 2-step reconsideration and post-service appeal process. Its provider appeal page says an expedited pre-service appeal may apply when standard timing risks the member's life or health, ability to regain maximum function, or management of severe pain; already-provided services are not eligible for urgent handling. Informational. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/claims-payments-billing/appeals.html>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

findings.description: UnitedHealthcare Commercial network-gap exception: service reference, in-network referrer, and clinical reason documented
findings.citation: UnitedHealthcare's Commercial Network Gap Exception Request Form applies when a provider explicitly requests a network-gap exception because local or specialty access is insufficient. It requires an existing prior-authorization service reference number, member and provider information including the in-network referrer, the specific clinical reason for a specialty exception, and supporting clinical documentation. <https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/prior-auth/UHC-Commercial-GAP-Application-form.pdf>
findings.evidence: Not a UnitedHealthcare packet; rule vacuously satisfied.

Medicare appeal amount-in-controversy thresholds (CY2026: ALJ $200, federal court $1,960; annually indexed, Fed Reg 2025-21879) backing appeal-deadline

CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization Final Rule (CMS-0057-F, 2024) decision windows (standard 7 calendar days, expedited 72 hours; effective 2026 for impacted payers) backing pa-turnaround

Medicare 60-day overpayment report-and-return rule (42 CFR 401.305; ACA 6402(a) / 42 U.S.C. 1320a-7k(d)) backing overpayment-60day
CMS Physician Fee Schedule conversion factor (CY2026: $32.7442 per RVU; annual PFS Final Rule) backing rvu-payment. Overridable per call to model a percent-of-Medicare contract.

Medicare sequestration rate (2% of the program-payment portion; Budget Control Act of 2011 Pub. L. 112-25 251A) backing sequestration-adjust. Overridable to model the suspended/phased rates Congress has set.
MPFS surgical payment percentages (assistant at surgery 16%; co-surgeon 62.5% to each; CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12 20.4.3/40.8) backing multi-surgeon-pay.

Multiple-procedure (100% highest / 50% each subsequent) and bilateral (150%) reduction factors and the MPFS MULT PROC / BILAT SURG indicator semantics (CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12 40.6/40.7) backing mppr and bilateral-pay.

NCCI procedure-to-procedure modifier-indicator semantics (0 = no modifier permitted; 1 = a permitted NCCI-associated modifier may bypass; 9 = edit deleted/not active) and the NCCI-associated-modifier set (anatomic, global-surgery, 59/X{EPSU}) backing ncci-ptp. NCCI Policy Manual Ch. I; Pub. 100-04 Ch. 23. No PTP edit file ships -- the indicator is entered.

MUE Adjudication Indicator (MAI) semantics (1 = claim-line edit; 2 = date-of-service absolute, never payable; 3 = date-of-service reviewable with documentation) backing mue-check. CMS Medically Unlikely Edits program. No MUE value table ships -- the value and MAI are entered.

The 59 / X{EPSU} distinct-procedural-service hierarchy (XE separate encounter, XS separate structure, XP separate practitioner, XU unusual non-overlapping; 59 only when no X-modifier fits) backing modifier-x-selector. CMS MLN 'Proper Use of Modifiers 59 & X{EPSU}'.

MPFS GLOB DAYS definitions (000/010/090 = 0/10/90 postoperative days, 090 adds 1 preoperative day; XXX/YYY/ZZZ/MMM non-numeric) and the global-package modifiers (24/25/57/58/78/79) backing global-period. CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12 40; MLN Global Surgery Booklet.

The pricing-before-informational modifier-sequencing convention and the pricing/informational classification of the common CPT/HCPCS modifiers backing modifier-order. CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12 / 23 modifier-reporting guidance and payer claim-editing convention.

The CPT 2023 E/M edition and the setting-specific MDM code maps (inpatient/observation 99221-99233, ED 99281-99285, nursing facility 99304-99310, home/residence 99341-99350; 99343 deleted 2023) backing em-mdm-2023. AMA CPT 2023 E/M Guidelines. No CPT descriptor file ships -- the MDM elements are entered.

The 99291 (first 30-74 min) / 99292 (each additional 30 min) critical-care time bands and the separately-reported-procedure subtraction rule backing critical-care-time. AMA CPT; CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12 30.6.12.

The split (or shared) visit substantive-portion policy, the FS modifier, and the 85% NPP payment percentage backing split-shared. CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12 30.6.18; PFS split/shared visit policy (2024 rule).

The prolonged-service add-on codes (AMA 99417/99418 vs Medicare G2212/G0316) and their per-primary-code time thresholds (99205 75/89, 99215 55/69, 99223 90/104, 99233 65/79; each unit +15 min) backing prolonged-services. AMA CPT; CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12.

The Medicare 8-minute rule band table (8-22=1, 23-37=2, 38-52=3, 53-67=4, each +15 adds a unit) and the AMA Rule of Eights per-service contrast backing therapy-units. CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 5 20.2; 42 CFR 410.

The anesthesia payment formula ((base+time+modifying units) x CF; time unit = 15 min), the default national anesthesia conversion factor (CY2025 $20.3178, overridable), and the medical-direction percentages (AA/QZ 100%, QK/QY/QX 50%, AD flat 3 base units) backing anesthesia-units. CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12 50; ASA RVG base units entered, not shipped.

The HCPCS Level II drug billing-unit-of-measure convention (dose / code billing-unit size, rounded per the descriptor's rule) backing ndc-hcpcs-units. The unit size is entered from the code descriptor -- no drug-pricing file ships. CMS HCPCS Level II descriptors; CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 17.

The single-dose-vial drug-wastage rule (administered on one line, discarded with modifier JW; JZ to attest zero waste, required since 2023-07-01) and the multi-dose-vial JW ineligibility gate backing drug-wastage. CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 17 §40; CMS JW/JZ modifier guidance.

The CPT 96360-96379 infusion/injection/hydration initial-code hierarchy (chemo > therapeutic > hydration; within a category, infusion > push), the one-initial-per-encounter rule, and the 16-minute infusion-to-push reclassification floor backing infusion-hierarchy. AMA CPT 96360-96379; CMS Pub. 100-04 Ch. 12.

The CMS CY2026 Medicare cost-sharing amounts (announced 2025-11-14) backing medicare-cost-share: Part A inpatient deductible $1,736/benefit period, days 61-90 coinsurance $434/day, lifetime-reserve $868/day, SNF days 21-100 $217/day; Part B annual deductible $283 then 20% of the approved amount. SSA Title XVIII; CMS annual cost-sharing notice. Overridable per call for a prior year.

The coordination-of-benefits methods (lesser-of, come-out-whole / benefits-less-paid, non-duplication) and the Medicare Secondary Payer calculation backing cob-calc. 42 CFR Part 411; CMS Pub. 100-05 (Medicare Secondary Payer Manual).

The No Surprises Act QPA-based patient cost-share rule (protected emergency / ancillary-at-in-network-facility services are cost-shared as if in-network off the Qualifying Payment Amount; balance billing prohibited) backing nsa-cost-share. PHS Act §2799A-1/§2799A-2; 45 CFR Part 149.

The IPPS operating and capital standardized base rates (wage-index adjusted) that, times the MS-DRG relative weight, give the base DRG payment backing drg-payment, before outlier/IME/DSH add-ons. The relative-weight table is the bundled data/drg corpus; the base rates are entered/dated constants. 42 CFR Part 412; CMS IPPS Final Rule.

The OPPS conversion factor (wage adjusted) that, times the APC relative weight, gives the APC payment backing apc-payment, plus the status-indicator packaging set and the multiple-procedure discount. The relative-weight/status table is the bundled data/apc corpus; the conversion factor is an entered/dated constant. 42 CFR Part 419; CMS OPPS Final Rule.

The CMS Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI) 11-character position grammar (numeric / alphabetic / alphanumeric by position) and the excluded-letter set S, L, O, I, B, Z backing mbi-validate. Validates format only, not active entitlement. CMS new Medicare card specification.
